title: Compose named failures into safe degraded advertising

verify.summary: Direct dependency TASK-046-T3-FT-003-W2 is blocked on stable managed kiosk runtime evidence after a second operator-reported Chrome crash; TASK-055 cannot be promoted or executed through that dependency.

Independent T2 verification passed FT-003-AC-008: fresh headless-Chromium evidence covered all five named degraded-advertising cases, focused lifecycle/wiring regressions passed, required mb-lint passed, and source review found no forbidden offline/fallback path or ownership duplication. Lifecycle remains in_progress for the explicit owner.

Explicit lifecycle owner closed TASK-055 after independent T2 verification PASS. FT-003-AC-008 named failure matrix, lifecycle/wiring regressions, required gates, forbidden-path review and ownership review are accepted.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-008 RED: named dependency failures are not composed into recoverable client states; GREEN: missing camera, unavailable sensor/service, BlazeFace load failure and missing optional audio/animation each keep or return the already loaded client to usable advertising with recoverable operator feedback, while optional assets never block capture or a valid result; decisive comparison: one injected fixture per named failure records advertising reachability/recovery affordance and observes prerequisite outcome/notice behavior only as integration, with no offline-metadata retention, expiry, replay or delivery path required; artifact: Playwright transcript and failure matrix under .tasks/TASK-055-T2-FT-003-W7/.
purpose: Compose already implemented dependencies into the feature's named degraded advertising matrix.
success_outcome: Every named failure leaves the loaded participant flow in usable advertising with truthful recoverable feedback and no optional-asset blockage.
anti_goals: Do not implement an offline-metadata outbox or any delivery path.
Do not re-own outcome/retry or communication-notice timing.
Do not add fallback transport, local bridge, durable sensor queue or server-side offline Attempt.

forbidden_scope: Happy-path camera/sensor/detector internals owned by prerequisite tasks
Outcome/retry and notice internals owned by TASK-053 and TASK-067
Any offline metadata persistence, replay or delivery mechanism
stop_conditions: A named failure cannot retain advertising without a forbidden fallback.
Operator feedback requires a new server channel.
Implementation starts depending on offline metadata delivery.

constraints: Use installed playwright cli with per-dependency failure injection against the already loaded client.
Central-origin unavailability after reload carries no advertising guarantee.
No offline-metadata artifact is necessary for acceptance.
invariants: Every named failure leaves or returns the loaded client to advertising.
Missing optional assets never block capture or a valid result.
Participant flow never depends on offline metadata retention or delivery.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-008 named failure matrix for advertising and recovery feedback.
Code/evidence review confirms absence of a mandatory offline metadata path and non-duplication of AC-007/AC-016.
